docs.title: ChatHFD：模型与数据集下载
docs.text:
用一个命令下载公开 Hugging Face 仓库。默认 HF-Mirror，aria2 提供分片与多文件并发；先预检文件与体量，再开始传输。

  • 第一次使用

    安装、检查 aria2、下载一个模型配置文件和一个小型数学数据集。

    进入快速开始

  • 查完整命令

    真实 CLI 树、全部参数、默认值、退出状态及安装确认行为。

    打开 CLI 树

  • 选择镜像与目录

    理清端点优先级、文件筛选、并发、固定版本和续传目录约束。

    阅读下载配置

  • 从 Python 调用

    复用元数据查询与下载函数，了解必填参数、输出和异常。

    查看 Python 接口

  • 了解能力边界

    区分公开仓库、认证仓库、兼容镜像与 ModelScope 独立平台。

    查看能力地图

  • 解决下载问题

    依赖缺失、目录冲突、网络错误和旧 HFD 参数迁移。

    打开故障排查

docs.title: 按任务选择入口
docs.text: 你要做什么 从哪里开始 是否写入文件 看一个仓库有哪些文件、总共多大 download --dry-run 不创建下载文件 下载模型配置或权重 模型示例 写入选中的文件 下载数学数据集 数据集示例 写入数据集仓库文件 检查或安装 aria2 setup 默认只检查；安装须确认 排查已有目录为什么被拒绝 目录与续传 不自动删除旧文件 看命令如何映射到代码 接口树 只读说明

docs.title: 最小可运行流程
docs.text:
pip install ChatHFD==0.1.4
chathfd setup
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --include config.json --dry-run

上面只查询配置文件元数据，不下载模型权重。继续操作见快速开始。

当前边界

仅支持公开仓库；不接收或转发账号 Token。完成后按文件大小校验，不做上游密码学哈希验证。10 GiB 是文件选择的元数据预检门槛，不是网络传输的硬限额。

docs.title: 已实现
docs.text: 能力 接口 边界 模型与数据集 download、--repo-type 仅公开仓库文件，不启动训练或推理 兼容镜像 --endpoint、HF_ENDPOINT 默认 HF-Mirror，无自动跨平台回退 并发与续传 --connections、--jobs 需本机 aria2，目录身份须匹配 文件和体量预检 --include、--exclude、--dry-run 元数据检查，不是网络硬限额 下载器准备 setup [--install] 安装是显式、需确认的系统包操作 Python 调用 download_repo、fetch_metadata、setup_aria2 目前仍使用 Click 输出/异常，见接口页

docs.title: 不在当前能力内
docs.text:
• Hugging Face 私有或 gated 仓库登录、Token 管理及转发。
  • ModelScope 原生下载、wget 后端、旧 hfd 别名自动替换。
  • 全局缓存目录管理、跨机器挂载、下载任务队列、后台守护进程。
  • 上游加密哈希验收、模型推理验证或数据集训练流水线。

不要把单个配置文件或 README 的成功下载称为“模型权重已经下载完成”。查看快速开始区分小样例和完整仓库。

docs.title: CLI 树与命令参考
docs.text: 完整树来自真实 chathfd --tree，不是规划中的命令。参数很多时，先看简明树，再进入对应动作。

docs.title: 简明命令树
docs.text:
chathfd
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── download  # Download a public model or dataset with aria2c.
└── setup  # Check the aria2c download engine and offer installation.

docs.title: 完整命令树
docs.text:
chathfd
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── download <REPO-ID> [--repo-type REPO-TYPE] [--revision REVISION] [--endpoint ENDPOINT] [--local-dir LOCAL-DIR] [--include INCLUDE] [--exclude EXCLUDE] [--connections CONNECTIONS] [--jobs JOBS] [--dry-run] [--allow-large]  # Download a public model or dataset with aria2c.
└── setup [--install]  # Check the aria2c download engine and offer installation.

docs.title: 根选项
docs.text: 选项 作用 副作用 --help 当前命令帮助 无下载 --version 已安装包版本 无下载 --tree 真实注册树，包含参数签名 无下载 --tree-brief 相同命令节点，省略参数签名 无下载

docs.title: 下载动作
docs.text:
chathfd download REPO_ID [OPTIONS]

REPO_ID 为 组织/仓库，也接受 Hub 支持的单段旧仓库名。模型和数据集共用同一个动作；预览是选项，不是另一个子命令。

参数 默认值 含义 --repo-type [model|dataset] model 仓库类型 --revision TEXT main 分支、标签或 commit --endpoint TEXT HF_ENDPOINT 或 HF-Mirror 兼容 HTTPS origin；显式选项优先 --local-dir DIRECTORY 当前目录下 models/ 或 datasets/ + repo ID 所选文件的输出根 --include TEXT 不限制 可重复的包含 glob --exclude TEXT 无 可重复的排除 glob --connections INTEGER 4，范围 1–10 每个文件的连接/分片数 --jobs INTEGER 5，范围 1–10 同时下载的文件数 --dry-run 关闭 查询并列出文件/大小，不创建下载文件 --allow-large 关闭 允许所选文件超过 10 GiB 后实际传输 --help — 仅显示本动作帮助

实际传输创建目标文件与 .chathfd 记录，并调用 aria2。预检与传输完成条件见下载配置。公开仓库以外的登录、Token、wget 和 ModelScope 后端不在当前参数面内。

chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --include config.json --dry-run
chathfd download MathArena/arxivmath-0926 --repo-type dataset --dry-run

docs.title: 下载器准备
docs.text:
chathfd setup [--install] [--help]
参数 行为 无选项 检查 aria2c；存在时打印路径，缺失时给出安装指引 --install 仅当缺失时提出明确安装命令；再次确认后才运行包管理器 --help 显示帮助，不安装

已有 aria2c 时不会重复安装。当前不安装外部 hfd.sh、不启动守护进程、不改镜像或下载目录配置。无人确认的安装不会继续；包管理器错误非零退出。

docs.title: 输出与退出状态
docs.text:
• 下载成功或预检完成：退出 0；输出选择信息，实际下载后输出按大小核验结果。
  • 参数错误、网络/元数据错误或实际下载不完整：非零退出；不要只解析“开始下载”字样判断成功。
  • setup 在检测/给出安装指引后可正常结束；退出 0 不等于缺失依赖已经安装，以 aria2c ready 和可执行文件为准。
  • 当前无 model、dataset、login、mirror 等额外子命令；勿把旧 hfd 参数当作本工具参数。

快速开始 · Python 接口 · 旧接口对照

docs.title: 下载配置
docs.text:
• 端点

    一个请求只使用一个 Hugging Face 兼容 HTTPS origin。

    端点优先级

  • 输出与续传

    一个目录对应固定仓库、commit 与文件集合。

    目录身份

  • 并发与筛选

    分别控制单文件连接和同时下载的文件数。

    传输参数

docs.title: 端点优先级
docs.text:
来源 优先级 示例 命令行 --endpoint 最高 --endpoint https://huggingface.co 进程环境 HF_ENDPOINT 其次 HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com 内置默认值 最后 https://hf-mirror.com 
HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --include config.json --dry-run
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --endpoint https://huggingface.co --include config.json --dry-run

端点必须是 HTTPS origin，不能带用户名、密码、路径、查询参数或片段。当前 CLI 不持久化这些设置，也不会自动在镜像之间重试或回退。Python download_repo() 的 endpoint 是显式参数，不会代为读取 HF_ENDPOINT。

ModelScope 不是兼容的 HF_ENDPOINT 替换地址。它有独立的仓库 ID、发布状态与 SDK；当前 ChatHFD 没有 ModelScope 后端。也不要用旧的 Token 参数为当前下载器添加认证。

docs.title: 文件筛选与并发
docs.text:
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
  --include 'config.json' --include 'generation_config.json' \
  --exclude 'README*' --connections 4 --jobs 5 --dry-run
  • --include 可重复，模式之间是“或”；未指定时选择所有文件。
  • --exclude 可重复，对匹配的仓库相对路径排除；排除优先于包含。
  • 用引号包住通配符，避免先被本地 shell 展开。
  • --connections 为每个文件的连接/分片数，默认 4；--jobs 为并发文件数，默认 5。CLI 两者均限制在 1–10，不保证乘积一定变成实际连接数。
  • --revision 接受分支、标签或 commit。下载 URL 固定为元数据返回的 commit，即使请求的是 main。

docs.title: 目录与续传身份
docs.text:
不传 --local-dir 时，模型写到 ./models/<org>/<repo>，数据集写到 ./datasets/<org>/<repo>；相对目录以命令启动位置为准。它不是 Hugging Face 标准缓存布局，也不会自动采用另一台机器的共享盘路径。

下载目录中生成：

<destination>/
├── <selected repository files>
└── .chathfd/
    ├── selection.json    # endpoint/repo/type/commit/选中文件名与大小
    └── urls.txt          # aria2 输入清单

再次执行时要求端点、仓库、类型、commit 和选中文件集合一致。可恢复的部分文件依赖 aria2 的 .aria2 状态；同尺寸完整文件会跳过。更换文件集合、镜像或 commit 时，请选择新目录。未知旧文件、符号链接、目录逃逸、内部文件名冲突和没有续传状态的错误尺寸文件会被拒绝，不会自动删除或覆盖来“修复”。

--dry-run 只预检元数据、文件选择和路径，不创建记录，也不检查实际下载阶段的全部目录身份条件；预检成功不保证旧目录可直接复用。

docs.title: 大文件与校验
docs.text:
行为 实际契约 超过 10 GiB 的选择 预览可成功；实际传输须 --allow-large 硬性网络配额 没有；大小来自服务端元数据 完成验收 文件存在、尺寸正确、没有残留 aria2 续传状态 加密哈希或模型可用性 当前不验证，不等于模型推理验收 下载器配置 禁用 aria2 默认配置和 netrc，避免隐式带出凭据

继续阅读完整参数表和故障排查。

docs.title: 从命令到文件
docs.text:
chathfd.cli                         # 只负责 CLI 参数和调用
├── main                            # --help / --version / --tree / --tree-brief
├── download REPO_ID
│   └── chathfd.download.download_repo(...)
│       ├── fetch_metadata(...)     # Hub 模型/数据集元数据
│       ├── 文件选择、路径与身份检查
│       ├── .chathfd/selection.json + urls.txt
│       └── aria2c                  # 并发、分片与续传
└── setup [--install]
    └── chathfd.setup.setup_aria2(...)
        ├── shutil.which           # 检查 aria2c 与包管理器
        └── 包管理器                # 只有明确安装并确认后执行

docs.title: 调用契约
docs.text:
接口 输入 输出 副作用 fetch_metadata endpoint、repo_id、repo_type、revision 元数据 dict HTTP GET；不写下载文件 download_repo 仓库、端点、目录、筛选、并发与开关 None；状态输出到控制台 非 dry-run 时写文件并运行 aria2 setup_aria2 install: bool None；检查/安装提示 默认不安装；显式模式仍需确认 ChathfdConfig ChatEnv provider 注册 schema 当前下载流程不使用其 API Key 认证

这些是当前导入面，不是 HTTP/MCP 服务，也没有独立的持久任务队列。download_repo() 的错误通过 click.ClickException 等异常报告，不返回结构化下载结果对象。

docs.title: 责任分工
docs.text:
• ChatStyle：真实 CLI 树、确认交互。
  • ChatEnv：已有 schema/provider 注册；不是当前 Hugging Face 登录实现。
  • ChatHFD：解析仓库元数据、选择文件、固定 commit、校验目标、构造 aria2 输入清单。
  • aria2：网络传输、分片和续传；不因为它退出成功就省略最终大小检查。

Python 调用示例 · 完整 CLI 参数

docs.title: Python 接口
docs.text:
• 查询元数据

    获取仓库 commit 与文件列表，不创建下载目录。

    查询示例

  • 执行或预览下载

    显式传入所有参数，复用与 CLI 相同的检查。

    下载示例

  • 检查下载器

    在调用端明确选择只检查或询问安装。

    依赖示例

docs.title: 查询元数据
docs.text:
from chathfd.download import DEFAULT_ENDPOINT, fetch_metadata

metadata = fetch_metadata(
    endpoint=DEFAULT_ENDPOINT,
    repo_id="Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next",
    repo_type="model",
    revision="main",
)
print(metadata["sha"])
print(len(metadata.get("siblings", [])))

返回 Hub JSON 对象；服务器响应未保证所有条目都有相同可选字段。该函数只查询，不做最终文件选择、目录身份或传输验收。

docs.title: 预览与下载
docs.text:
from pathlib import Path
import click
from chathfd.download import DEFAULT_ENDPOINT, download_repo

try:
    download_repo(
        repo_id="Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next",
        repo_type="model",
        revision="main",
        endpoint=DEFAULT_ENDPOINT,
        local_dir=Path("models/qwen-config"),
        includes=("config.json",),
        excludes=(),
        connections=4,
        jobs=5,
        dry_run=True,
        allow_large=False,
    )
except click.ClickException as exc:
    print(f"下载未完成：{exc.format_message()}")

示例是元数据预览。实际写入需把 dry_run 改成 False；数据集调用改为 repo_type="dataset"，并显式提供数据集 ID 与新目录。includes/excludes 是字符串元组，不是用空格分隔的一个长字符串。

参数 类型或要求 repo_id、repo_type、revision 字符串；类型用 model 或 dataset endpoint Hugging Face 兼容 HTTPS origin；显式传入，不自动读环境变量 local_dir Path 或 None；None 使用当前目录下的默认布局 includes、excludes tuple[str, ...] connections、jobs 整数；Python 调用方应使用与 CLI 相同的 1–10 范围 dry_run、allow_large 布尔值

函数返回 None，状态通过 Click 输出。元数据/下载失败会抛出 click.ClickException；本地文件系统失败还可能抛出 OSError。它不是静默后台下载 API，暂不返回文件清单结果对象。

docs.title: 检查下载器
docs.text:
from chathfd.setup import setup_aria2

setup_aria2(install=False)  # 只检查并提示，不修改系统包

install=True 仍会确认；不要在无人值守进程中假设它能自动获得 root 权限。完整行为见 setup。

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text:
先选一个小范围任务，确认下载器、镜像和目录可用，再考虑完整权重。以下命令使用当前真实 CLI；不需要 Hugging Face 账号或 API Key。

  • 准备环境

    Python 3.10+、ChatHFD 与 aria2。

    安装与检查

  • 模型小样例

    只取 Qwen 配置文件，不拉取整套权重。

    下载模型配置

  • 数学数据集

    下载一个小型公开数据集仓库。

    下载数据集

  • 完整权重

    先核对文件清单、磁盘和网络，再显式放行大体量选择。

    查看大文件流程

docs.title: 1. 安装与检查
docs.text:
在自己的 Python 虚拟环境中安装，不需要修改系统 Python：

python -m pip install ChatHFD==0.1.4
chathfd --version
chathfd --tree
chathfd setup

setup 找到 aria2c 时输出可执行文件路径。缺少时会显示安装建议；需要工具尝试安装时再执行：

chathfd setup --install

它会再次确认后才调用已识别的包管理器。Linux 使用 apt-get、dnf 或 pacman，Homebrew 可用时使用 brew；没有支持的管理器时给出错误，需要自行安装。非 root 的 Linux 尝试使用 sudo -n，不会在后台等候密码。不要把密码输入到日志或聊天中。

docs.title: 2. 只预检，不下载
docs.text:
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
  --include 'config.json' \
  --dry-run

输出包含仓库类型、请求版本、固定 commit、选中文件、字节数和目标路径。--dry-run 不创建下载目录，也不要求 aria2c 已安装。

docs.title: 3. 下载模型配置文件
docs.text:
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
  --include 'config.json' \
  --local-dir ./models/qwen-config \
  --connections 4 \
  --jobs 5

目标是 ./models/qwen-config/config.json。这只是模型配置，不含权重，不能单凭它运行模型推理。需要固定某个版本时加 --revision，例如模型页给出的 commit。

相同端点、仓库、commit 和文件选择可再次执行同一命令；完整文件会跳过，aria2 状态允许继续未完成传输。若改变了选中文件集合或分支已经更新，请使用新目录，详见续传约束。

docs.title: 4. 下载数学数据集
docs.text:
chathfd download MathArena/arxivmath-0926 \
  --repo-type dataset \
  --dry-run

chathfd download MathArena/arxivmath-0926 \
  --repo-type dataset \
  --local-dir ./datasets/arxivmath-0926 \
  --connections 4 \
  --jobs 3

这里下载数据集仓库文件，包含说明与 Parquet 分片；不是自动加载到训练器中。数据含义、许可和用途请以数据集卡为准。

docs.title: 5. 完整权重与大文件
docs.text:
# 只列出文件与大小
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --dry-run

查看完整模型仓库时不要把小样例的下载量当成权重总量。先核对磁盘、带宽和模型许可；必要时用 --include '*.safetensors' 等模式缩小范围。若所选文件超过 10 GiB，实际传输需明确加 --allow-large；本页不自动启动大规模下载。

docs.title: 故障排查与旧接口
docs.text:
先根据错误选择下一步；不要用删除目录、传 Token 或反复重试来掩盖条件不满足。

docs.title: ChatHFD: model and dataset downloads
docs.text:
Download public Hugging Face repositories with one command. HF-Mirror is the default endpoint; aria2 provides split and multi-file concurrency. Preview the selected files and size before transferring them.

  • Start here

    Install the package, check aria2, and download a model config and a small math dataset.

    Open Quickstart

  • Find a command

    Real CLI trees, every option, defaults, exit behavior and installation confirmation.

    Open CLI Tree

  • Choose endpoint and output

    Endpoint precedence, file filters, concurrency, pinned revisions and resume identity.

    Read Configuration

  • Call from Python

    Reuse metadata and download functions with their exact arguments, output and errors.

    View Python API

  • Understand the boundary

    Public versus authenticated repositories, compatible mirrors and the separate ModelScope platform.

    View Capability Map

  • Resolve a failure

    Missing dependencies, destination conflicts, network errors and legacy HFD flags.

    Open Troubleshooting

docs.title: Choose by task
docs.text: Task Starting point File effects Inspect repository files and size download --dry-run No download files created Download model config or weights Model example Writes selected files Download a math dataset Dataset example Writes repository files Check or install aria2 setup Read-only unless installation is confirmed Understand a rejected directory Output and resume Existing files are not deleted Map commands to implementation Interface Tree Reference only

docs.title: Minimal working path
docs.text:
pip install ChatHFD==0.1.4
chathfd setup
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --include config.json --dry-run

This only queries metadata for a config file, not model weights. Continue with Quickstart.

Current boundary

Public repositories only; no account token input or forwarding. Completion checks file sizes, not upstream cryptographic hashes. The 10 GiB gate is metadata preflight on the file selection, not a hard network-byte quota.

docs.title: Capability Map
docs.text:
• Repository files

    Public models and datasets, selection, revision and output.

    Run examples

  • Preflight and resume

    Explicit selection, commit pinning and destination identity; size-based completion checks.

    Read constraints

  • Reusable interfaces

    CLI adapters call importable Python functions; aria2 transfers files.

    Interface mapping

docs.title: Implemented
docs.text: Capability Interface Boundary Models and datasets download, --repo-type Public repository files, not training or inference Compatible mirrors --endpoint, HF_ENDPOINT HF-Mirror by default; no cross-platform fallback Concurrency and resume --connections, --jobs Local aria2 and matching destination identity Selection and size preview --include, --exclude, --dry-run Metadata preflight, not a hard byte quota Engine preparation setup [--install] Explicit, confirmed system package installation Python calls download_repo, fetch_metadata, setup_aria2 Still use Click output/errors; see API reference

docs.title: Outside the current boundary
docs.text:
• Login, token management or forwarding for private/gated Hub repositories.
  • Native ModelScope downloads, wget backend or automatic replacement of old hfd aliases.
  • Global cache management, remote filesystem mounts, job queues or background daemons.
  • Upstream cryptographic verification, inference validation or dataset training pipelines.

A successful config or README download is not a completed weight download. Quickstart distinguishes small examples from full repositories.

docs.title: CLI Tree and command reference
docs.text: The complete tree comes from real chathfd --tree output, not a roadmap. Start with the brief view and then inspect each action.

docs.title: Brief command tree
docs.text:
chathfd
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── download  # Download a public model or dataset with aria2c.
└── setup  # Check the aria2c download engine and offer installation.

docs.title: Complete command tree
docs.text:
chathfd
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
├── download <REPO-ID> [--repo-type REPO-TYPE] [--revision REVISION] [--endpoint ENDPOINT] [--local-dir LOCAL-DIR] [--include INCLUDE] [--exclude EXCLUDE] [--connections CONNECTIONS] [--jobs JOBS] [--dry-run] [--allow-large]  # Download a public model or dataset with aria2c.
└── setup [--install]  # Check the aria2c download engine and offer installation.

docs.title: Root options
docs.text: Option Purpose Effects --help Help for the current command No download --version Installed package version No download --tree Registered tree with parameter signatures No download --tree-brief Same commands without signatures No download

docs.title: Download action
docs.text:
chathfd download REPO_ID [OPTIONS]

REPO_ID is organization/repository, or a supported legacy single-name Hub repository. Models and datasets share one action; preview is an option, not a subcommand.

Option Default Meaning --repo-type [model|dataset] model Repository type --revision TEXT main Branch, tag or commit --endpoint TEXT HF_ENDPOINT or HF-Mirror Compatible HTTPS origin; explicit option wins --local-dir DIRECTORY Current-directory models/ or datasets/ + repo ID Selected file output root --include TEXT All files Repeatable include glob --exclude TEXT None Repeatable exclude glob --connections INTEGER 4, range 1–10 Connections/splits per file --jobs INTEGER 5, range 1–10 Concurrent files --dry-run Off Query and list files/sizes without creating download files --allow-large Off Permit transfer of a selection over 10 GiB --help — Show action help only

An actual transfer writes files and .chathfd records and invokes aria2. See Configuration for preflight and completion conditions. Login, token forwarding, wget and native ModelScope are outside the implemented option surface.

chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --include config.json --dry-run
chathfd download MathArena/arxivmath-0926 --repo-type dataset --dry-run

docs.title: Engine preparation
docs.text:
chathfd setup [--install] [--help]
Input Behavior No options Check aria2c; print path when present or installation guidance otherwise --install If missing, show the proposed command and require confirmation before a package-manager call --help Show help without installation

An existing aria2c is not reinstalled. This does not install external hfd.sh, launch a daemon or persist endpoint/output settings. Installation does not proceed without confirmation; manager errors fail nonzero.

docs.title: Output and exit behavior
docs.text:
• Successful preview or verified download exits 0 and prints selection information; completed transfer adds size-verification output.
  • Invalid input, failed network/metadata or incomplete transfer fails nonzero. A start message is not a completion receipt.
  • Setup can exit normally after detecting or suggesting installation. Exit 0 alone does not prove a missing engine was installed; require aria2c ready and the executable.
  • No extra model, dataset, login or mirror subcommands exist. Legacy hfd flags are not current options.

Quickstart · Python API · Legacy comparison

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
• Endpoint

    Use one Hugging Face-compatible HTTPS origin per invocation.

    Endpoint precedence

  • Output and resume

    A destination belongs to one repository, commit and file selection.

    Destination identity

  • Selection and concurrency

    Control connections per file separately from concurrent files.

    Transfer settings

docs.title: Endpoint precedence
docs.text:
Source Priority Example CLI --endpoint Highest --endpoint https://huggingface.co Process HF_ENDPOINT Next HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com Built-in default Last https://hf-mirror.com 
HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --include config.json --dry-run
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --endpoint https://huggingface.co --include config.json --dry-run

The endpoint must be an HTTPS origin without userinfo, path, query or fragment. The CLI does not persist settings, automatically retry another mirror or silently fall back. Python download_repo() takes an explicit endpoint; it does not load HF_ENDPOINT for you.

ModelScope is not an interchangeable HF_ENDPOINT. It has separate repository IDs, availability and an SDK; ChatHFD has no ModelScope backend. Legacy token flags do not add authentication to the current downloader.

docs.title: File selection and concurrency
docs.text:
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
  --include 'config.json' --include 'generation_config.json' \
  --exclude 'README*' --connections 4 --jobs 5 --dry-run
  • Repeat --include for an OR across patterns; without it all files are selected.
  • Repeated --exclude patterns remove matching repository-relative paths; exclusion wins.
  • Quote globs to prevent local shell expansion.
  • --connections controls per-file connections/splits (default 4); --jobs concurrent files (default 5). Both CLI ranges are 1–10; their product is not a promise of actual active connections.
  • --revision accepts a branch, tag or commit. Resolve URLs use the commit returned by metadata, even when the request names main.

docs.title: Output and resume identity
docs.text:
Without --local-dir, models use ./models/<org>/<repo> and datasets ./datasets/<org>/<repo>, relative to the invocation directory. This is not the standard Hugging Face cache layout and does not infer another machine's shared-storage paths.

<destination>/
├── <selected repository files>
└── .chathfd/
    ├── selection.json    # endpoint/repo/type/commit/names and sizes
    └── urls.txt          # aria2 input list

A repeat invocation must match endpoint, repository, type, commit and selected file set. Partial transfers require aria2 .aria2 state; complete same-size files are skipped. Use a fresh directory when changing file sets, endpoint or commit. Unknown existing files, symlinks, path escapes, internal-name collisions and wrong-size files without resume state are rejected, not silently deleted or overwritten.

Dry-run checks metadata, selection and paths only. It creates no receipt and does not perform every destination-identity check required for an actual transfer; a successful preview does not guarantee a pre-existing destination can be reused.

docs.title: Large selections and verification
docs.text:
Behavior Contract Selection above 10 GiB Preview succeeds; transfer requires --allow-large Hard network-byte quota None; sizes come from server metadata Completion Files exist with expected size and no remaining aria2 state Cryptographic hashes or inference Not verified Downloader configuration Default aria2 config and netrc are disabled to avoid implicit credentials

Continue with all options and Troubleshooting.

docs.title: From command to files
docs.text:
chathfd.cli                         # CLI inputs and dispatch
├── main                            # --help / --version / --tree / --tree-brief
├── download REPO_ID
│   └── chathfd.download.download_repo(...)
│       ├── fetch_metadata(...)     # Hub model/dataset metadata
│       ├── selection, path and identity checks
│       ├── .chathfd/selection.json + urls.txt
│       └── aria2c                  # concurrency, splits and resume
└── setup [--install]
    └── chathfd.setup.setup_aria2(...)
        ├── shutil.which           # aria2c and package-manager detection
        └── package manager        # explicit installation and confirmation only

docs.title: Call contracts
docs.text:
API Input Output Effects fetch_metadata endpoint, repo_id, repo_type, revision Metadata dict HTTP GET; no download files download_repo repository, endpoint, directory, filters, concurrency and switches None; console output Writes files and runs aria2 unless dry-run setup_aria2 install: bool None; check/install messages No installation by default; explicit mode still confirms ChathfdConfig ChatEnv provider registration Schema Its API key is not downloader authentication

These are importable functions, not HTTP/MCP services or a persistent task queue. download_repo() reports failures through exceptions such as click.ClickException, not a structured result object.

docs.title: Ownership
docs.text:
• ChatStyle owns real CLI trees and confirmation interaction.
  • ChatEnv provides the existing schema registration, not Hugging Face login here.
  • ChatHFD selects files, pins commits, validates destinations and builds aria2 input.
  • aria2 transfers bytes with splits and resume; successful process exit does not replace final size checks.

Python examples · All CLI options

docs.title: Python API
docs.text:
• Query metadata

    Read commit and file metadata without a destination directory.

    Metadata example

  • Preview or transfer

    Pass all inputs explicitly and reuse the CLI's download checks.

    Download example

  • Check the engine

    Explicitly choose read-only checks or confirmed installation.

    Dependency example

docs.title: Query metadata
docs.text:
from chathfd.download import DEFAULT_ENDPOINT, fetch_metadata

metadata = fetch_metadata(
    endpoint=DEFAULT_ENDPOINT,
    repo_id="Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next",
    repo_type="model",
    revision="main",
)
print(metadata["sha"])
print(len(metadata.get("siblings", [])))

This returns the Hub JSON object; optional fields can vary. It does not perform final selection, destination-identity validation or transfer verification.

docs.title: Preview and download
docs.text:
from pathlib import Path
import click
from chathfd.download import DEFAULT_ENDPOINT, download_repo

try:
    download_repo(
        repo_id="Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next",
        repo_type="model",
        revision="main",
        endpoint=DEFAULT_ENDPOINT,
        local_dir=Path("models/qwen-config"),
        includes=("config.json",),
        excludes=(),
        connections=4,
        jobs=5,
        dry_run=True,
        allow_large=False,
    )
except click.ClickException as exc:
    print(f"Download incomplete: {exc.format_message()}")

The example is a metadata-only preview. Set dry_run=False to write files. For a dataset, use repo_type="dataset" and an explicit dataset ID and new output directory. Filters are tuples of strings, not one whitespace-separated string.

Argument Type or requirement repo_id, repo_type, revision Strings; type is model or dataset endpoint Explicit compatible HTTPS origin; not loaded from the environment local_dir Path or None; None uses the current-directory layout includes, excludes tuple[str, ...] connections, jobs Integers; Python callers should retain the CLI's 1–10 range dry_run, allow_large Booleans

The function returns None and uses Click output. Metadata/transfer failures raise click.ClickException; filesystem failures can raise OSError. It is not a silent background API or a structured file-result service.

docs.title: Check the engine
docs.text:
from chathfd.setup import setup_aria2

setup_aria2(install=False)  # Read-only; does not change system packages

install=True still confirms. Unattended callers must not assume root authorization. See the setup reference.

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text:
Start with a small selection to check the engine, endpoint and destination before downloading complete weights. These examples use implemented commands and require no Hugging Face account or API key.

  • Prepare

    Python 3.10+, ChatHFD and aria2.

    Install and check

  • Small model example

    Fetch only a Qwen config, not the full weights.

    Download config

  • Math dataset

    Download a small public dataset repository.

    Download dataset

  • Complete weights

    Review files, disk and network before opting into a large selection.

    Large-file workflow

docs.title: 1. Install and check
docs.text:
Use your own Python virtual environment instead of modifying system Python:

python -m pip install ChatHFD==0.1.4
chathfd --version
chathfd --tree
chathfd setup

When aria2c is available, setup prints its executable path. Otherwise it suggests an installation command. To let the tool attempt installation, run:

chathfd setup --install

A second confirmation is required before invoking the detected package manager. It uses apt-get, dnf or pacman on Linux, or brew when available. With no supported manager, install aria2 separately. Non-root Linux installation uses sudo -n; it does not wait for a password in the background. Keep passwords out of logs and chat.

docs.title: 2. Preview without transfer
docs.text:
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
  --include 'config.json' \
  --dry-run

Output includes the repository type, requested revision, pinned commit, selected files, byte counts and destination. Dry-run does not create a download directory and does not require aria2c to be installed.

docs.title: 3. Download a model config
docs.text:
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
  --include 'config.json' \
  --local-dir ./models/qwen-config \
  --connections 4 \
  --jobs 5

The target is ./models/qwen-config/config.json. This is configuration only, not weights; it cannot run inference by itself. Add --revision to request a model-page commit or another fixed version.

Rerun the same command for the same endpoint, repository, commit and file selection. Complete files are skipped; aria2 state permits continuation. If the selected set changes or a branch moves, choose a fresh directory. See resume identity.

docs.title: 4. Download a math dataset
docs.text:
chathfd download MathArena/arxivmath-0926 \
  --repo-type dataset \
  --dry-run

chathfd download MathArena/arxivmath-0926 \
  --repo-type dataset \
  --local-dir ./datasets/arxivmath-0926 \
  --connections 4 \
  --jobs 3

This fetches repository files, including the README and Parquet shard; it does not load them into a trainer. Check the dataset card for content, license and intended use.

docs.title: 5. Complete weights and large selections
docs.text:
# List files and sizes only
chathfd download Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next --dry-run

A config-only example's transferred bytes do not represent a full model's weight size. Review disk space, bandwidth and license; narrow with patterns such as --include '*.safetensors' when appropriate. Actual selections above 10 GiB require an explicit --allow-large; this page does not automatically launch a large transfer.

docs.title: Troubleshooting and legacy interfaces
docs.text:
Choose the next action from the failure, rather than deleting evidence, adding tokens or blindly retrying.

Symptom Meaning Next action Missing aria2c Transfer engine unavailable Run chathfd setup; use setup --install explicitly if needed Installer fails or no manager Manager, permission or host prerequisite missing Install interactively as advised; no passwords in argv Metadata HTTP/network failure Endpoint, repository or network unavailable Check repo card, type and existing network route; choose --endpoint explicitly No matching files Filters selected nothing Check repository-relative paths and quote globs Above 10 GiB Large file selection Preview first; use --allow-large only after resource review Destination belongs to another selection Endpoint/repo/type/commit/file set changed Choose a new directory; do not remove the receipt to fake resume Existing files without a receipt Provenance is unknown Preserve files and choose a fresh destination Wrong size without .aria2 Existing file cannot safely resume Deliberately move it aside and use a new directory Interrupted transfer aria2 has not completed Rerun the same pinned commit and selection Gated/private repository rejected Authentication unsupported Use official tooling and its authorization flow; no keys in this command

docs.title: Migrating from old HFD
docs.text:
This is a comparison, not a claim that old aliases or flags still exist.

Old input Current input Difference hfd REPO_ID chathfd download REPO_ID Separate root and action -d / --dataset --repo-type dataset No current -d alias -x 4 --connections 4 Per-file connections; --jobs controls concurrent files --tool wget No equivalent backend aria2 only --hf_username / --hf_token No equivalent options Public repositories only Host-specific shared default Explicit --local-dir No shared-mount or global-cache management Fetching external hfd.sh No external hfd.sh needed Package Python code coordinates aria2

Old aliases, backend paths and logs may contain host-specific configuration. Do not copy them into public docs or fill legacy examples with real tokens. Define a new backend/authentication contract before adding it; changing an endpoint does not implement a separate platform.

All options · Resume identity · Capability boundary
